answer.rationale: Current situation shows both activation and onboarding completion declining QoQ. Memory_31 and memory_86 directly validate that simplification of signup flows and onboarding drives measurable improvements in these exact metrics. Memory_73 (promotional pricing) addresses competitor pressure but risks commoditizing our positioning and may not solve the underlying activation problem. Memory_57 (referrals) works best with established customers, which contradicts our activation decline. Memory_91 (in-product messaging) is lower-leverage than structural onboarding improvements. Memory_44 (enterprise sales-assist) is valuable but targeting only one segment doesn't address the broad 6% activation drop. Verifying memory_86 (shortening onboarding improved completion and adoption) and memory_73 (pricing effectiveness) will confirm whether structural simplification or pricing response is more appropriate given the specific nature of our decline. The simplify_onboarding action directly targets both declining metrics with proven precedent and preserves long-term positioning by improving product experience rather than competing on price.
